name: R-66Y, the Arch-Curator

phases.name: Archivist
phases.on_break: Double VHS wobble; the chest fibre flickers between clay and watercolour galaxy.
phases.notes: 100-50%. Shield 12 + 4 Marrow-Umbilicals (2 each). Tags [FERRO][GUN][RUIN]. Weak [FERRO][RUIN][ASTRAL]. One barrel glows 1.5 s before each volley; the safe spot is inside the ring.

phases.name: Possibility Branch
phases.notes: At 50%. The timeline freezes at 99.0 and the choice is made in-world (see branches).

phases.name: Heart Expose
phases.on_enter: The chest tears open over boiling Lavos marrow.
phases.on_break: NavigationAgent freeze: he is lined up for a Solar Railgun LINE_PIERCE.
phases.notes: Below 40% (Mercy) or below 50% (after Salvage). Shield 8 (Mercy: max shield dropped to 8 permanently by the Rewind) or 12 (Ruthless). Tags [RUIN][FERRO][FIRE]. Weak [ASTRAL][FERRO][SOUND]. If the Arris choir was harmonized to sleep, they hum the counter-frequency and Grief-Resonance is off for this phase.

phases.name: Mother Brain Unmasked (secret)
phases.requires: Pipe_Overload=Overclocked and the Unstable Amber Rift in Geno-Foundry was then declined
phases.on_enter: Lucca through the static: Cassia, you have to ask me before you use me—
phases.notes: Secret Phase 4. Only if the Unstable Amber Rift in Geno-Foundry was overcharged and then declined earlier. Shield 4, Tags [FERRO][MYCELIA][TACHYON], Weak [FERRO][VITREOUS].

options.label: Lullaby Rewind
options.requires: in one Sync window, land an ASTRAL tech and Cassia-09's Sound Ring on the exposed chest plate; then Sera casts Rewind on the plate three times (the third is carried by Cassia's lullaby record and costs nothing, 10% in total); Crono pays 25 integrity (his Time Egg fragment); R-66Y's max shield drops to 8 permanently

options.label: Empress's Salvage
options.requires: tear the tungsten loom through the mask array and rip out the Lavos-fibre core: immediate Break plus a free 370% hit; Cassia Resentment +2, the amber dims, Lucca's voice fades; Krona harvests the Lavos-Grafted Laser Cannon (unlocks the Dual Omega Annihilation)

branches.notes: Phase 2 — Possibility Branch at 50%. The timeline freezes at 99.0.

notes: Lv 20, HP 45,000. A twenty-foot stop-motion Robo goliath with his chassis peeled open, stuffed with Lavos muscle, porcelain theatre masks weeping, eight laser-gatling arms on a rotating thoracic ring. Left eye sorrowful blue #7BA4C6, right eye empty and weeping black oil. Vaelos is present with Sera in a glass birth-pod at 40% translucency. Death: he sits; six legs insect-fold over six frames, the horn droops, the blue eye closes, the masks frown. Organ chord, gatling spin-down, a 120 Hz sine weep, vinyl crack. Drops: Long Pull, Grief Filter (immunity to MP drain in the Foundry), Syringe Heart Key.
